en.html:
Deep inside Fudaraku Castle, at the back of the Lord of Horigoe's residential quarters, was this room.

For one person only, it had been prepared.
en.text:
Deep inside Fudaraku Castle, at the back of the Lord of Horigoe's residential quarters, was this room.

For one person only, it had been prepared.

ja.html:
普陀楽城内、堀越公方居住区の奥。
　この一室はそこにある。

　ただ一人の人間ために用意された一間だ。
ja.text:
普陀楽城内、堀越公方居住区の奥。
　この一室はそこにある。

　ただ一人の人間ために用意された一間だ。

en.html:
Her eyes were open. She was looking at me. But empty eyes, those—no light of her own will in them.

Only in deep sleep could Hikaru now have her mind and body back. Awake, they were not hers to command.

In dreams only, she could live.

And even that life had little time left.
en.text:
Her eyes were open. She was looking at me. But empty eyes, those—no light of her own will in them.

Only in deep sleep could Hikaru now have her mind and body back. Awake, they were not hers to command.

In dreams only, she could live.

And even that life had little time left.

ja.html:
部屋の主は両眼を開き、俺を見ている。
　しかしその瞳は虚ろで――意思の輝きが無い。

　光はもはや、深い眠りに落ちた時しか、心身の自由
を取り戻せないのだ。

　夢の中でしか生きられないのだ。

　そしてその寿命すら、もう長くはない。
ja.text:

en.html:
They had brought her here from Horigoe the day before Chachamaru left for Sasagawa. Since then, every day without fail, I had visited at least once.

Something one could believe in without condition.

Here it was. Here, now.
en.text:
They had brought her here from Horigoe the day before Chachamaru left for Sasagawa. Since then, every day without fail, I had visited at least once.

Something one could believe in without condition.

Here it was. Here, now.

ja.html:
堀越からここへ運び込まれたのは、茶々丸が篠川へ
向かう前日だった。
　以来俺は必ず、日に一度はこの室を訪れている。

　無条件で信じられる価値。

　それは今、ここにある。
ja.text:
堀越からここへ運び込まれたのは、茶々丸が篠川へ
向かう前日だった。
　以来俺は必ず、日に一度はこの室を訪れている。

　無条件で信じられる価値。

　それは今、ここにある。

en.html: Again I murmured her name, as if taking a vow. What I had to protect. Everything I had. The one I loved. My family. One person left, and no other. Yes. For this only, I fought. Whatever was required, I would get it done. If that meant dragging this so-called God up from under the earth and giving it to Hikaru—◆then I would do exactly that. I had to. There was no 'perhaps' in this matter. However much calamity it brought!!
en.text:
Again I murmured her name, as if taking a vow.

What I had to protect.
Everything I had.

The one I loved.

My family. One person left, and no other.

Yes. For this only, I fought.

Whatever was required, I would get it done.

If that meant dragging this so-called God up from under the earth and giving it to Hikaru—◆then I would do exactly that.

I had to. There was no 'perhaps' in this matter.
However much calamity it brought!!

ja.html: 誓うように、もう一度呟く。 　守るべき価値。 　俺の全て。 　愛するもの。 　最後に残った、一人きりの家族。 　――そうだ。 　このためだけに、俺は戦う。 　どんな事でも成し遂げてみせる。 　地の底の神とやらを引きずり出し、光に与える事が 必要ならば――――◆俺はそうする。 　しなくてはならない。 　それがどれほどの災厄をもたらそうとも!!
ja.text:
誓うように、もう一度呟く。

　守るべき価値。
　俺の全て。

　愛するもの。

　最後に残った、一人きりの家族。

　――そうだ。
　このためだけに、俺は戦う。

　どんな事でも成し遂げてみせる。

　地の底の神とやらを引きずり出し、光に与える事が
必要ならば――――◆俺はそうする。

　しなくてはならない。
　それがどれほどの災厄をもたらそうとも!!
